summary: @servicetitan/marketing-ui preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `scripts.preinstall` runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`), extracts it into a temp directory, sets it executable, and then invokes it against a package-local `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-CJS bundle heavily obfuscated with a rotated string-array plus rotation function (`function WV8StW(...) { for (...) MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift()); return MmgoCP }`) and hex-mangled identifiers. It is not referenced by the package's declared `main` (`dist/index.js`) and executes only through the preinstall→Bun bootstrap path. The package's advertised purpose is a React marketing-UI component library, which has no legitimate need to ship a 727 KB obfuscated Bun bundle or to install Bun at package install time. On `npm install`, the preinstall hook automatically runs the Bun runtime against attacker-chosen obfuscated bytes on the installer's host, bypassing scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
